jobs.title: Biobank Lead (Senior Manager / Associate Director)
jobs.description:
About the role

Quotient is seeking an experienced, detail-oriented operational leader to run the management, process control, governance and quality leadership of its research tissue bank. Quotient's human tissue bank is the foundation of our proprietary high-resolution somatic genetics platform, which delivers insights into cellular and organ disease biology and discovers novel targets for the development of new medicines.

You will lead across the whole sample lifecycle, from procurement review and receipt through storage, use, reuse, transfer and disposal, and keep Quotient compliant with its Human Tissue Authority (HTA) research licence.

Reporting to the Head of Research Strategy and Operations, you will work closely with the Director of Partnerships to check that proposed research fits the permissions and restrictions attached to each collection. You will also be the central point of coordination between laboratory teams, Facilities, Procurement and Logistics, Project Leads and Data Infrastructure, so that colleagues get timely access to suitable samples with full end-to-end traceability.

This role combines ownership of the tissue bank with practical oversight of delivery. Success means reliable, well-organised inventory and chain-of-custody records, timely availability of samples for research, compliance with internal SOPs and HTA regulations, and effective resolution of any sample-related incidents.

The Context Engine team builds the knowledge layer that AI agents use to work with enterprise data in Elasticsearch. We extract knowledge from any data sources into a structured AI Index, serve it to agents through public APIs, MCP tools and framework integrations, and close the loop with agent traces so that what the engine knows improves from real usage. Any agent can use it: Elastic’s own Agent Builder, Claude Code, LangChain and other third-party harnesses.

As a Principal AI Engineer, you own the improvement loop of this product end to end: how agents, automations and skills behave in production, how we observe them, how we evaluate them, and how we ship changes to them safely. Ce que vous construisez ne reste pas à l’état de démonstration : de vrais utilisateurs, au sein de grands groupes, s’en servent chaque jour. Applications et agents se conçoivent et s’exploitent en binôme avec l’AI Product Manager. Une équipe sinistres retrouve ainsi sur un seul écran les documents utiles et un brouillon de réponse ; ailleurs, un processus de commande ne demande plus aucune ressaisie manuelle.

Ce poste est fait pour vous si vous voulez que de vrais utilisateurs s’appuient sur ce que vous livrez.

Artefact accompagne les plus grandes entreprises du monde dans le déploiement de l’IA : 3 000 AI makers dans plus de 30 pays, plus de 1 000 clients. En France, le département Engineering réunit environ 300 personnes sous la responsabilité du CTO ; vous y rejoignez le chapter AI Applied Engineer, archétype Product Engineer.

 

Activités et responsabilités

À chaque projet, l’AI Product Manager pilote le produit avec le client : ce qui se construit en premier, et la vérification que les utilisateurs s’en servent, se décident à deux.

Autour de l’application, trois métiers se croisent : les AI Engineers pour le comportement du modèle, les Platform Engineers pour le déploiement, les Context & Analytics Engineers pour les données dont l’application a besoin. Les tests se font avec les utilisateurs finaux, le code se relit entre pairs et les nouvelles recrues

jobs.title: ML Hydrologist, Flood Forecasting
jobs.description: About the Role Global ML flood models now outperform traditional approaches on large rivers, but they still break down in the small, fast catchments where flash floods happen. Riverkin, a VC-backed ETH Zürich Spin-off, is closing that gap. We start from hydrological models trained across thousands of catchments worldwide and make them accurate locally, using a sensor network we deploy ourselves in exactly the places public datasets don't reach. We are looking for an ML hydrologist to own that work. You will report to the CTO and work directly with our other hydrologist, who covers rainfall radar and short-term nowcasting. Why this is interesting Data nobody else has: Our own field-deployed sensors give you live streamflow observations in small, previously ungauged catchments. An open problem: Whether large-sample models can be made reliable at flash-flood scale is unsolved, and you would be working on it with real data and real users. Built to protect lives and critical infrastructure: Your models will power early flood warning systems safeguarding hydropower plants and giving first responders more time to protect communities Publishing and open source: We encourage publishing results and contributing to open tools such as NeuralHydrology and Caravan. Compute: GPU resources are available for training and experimentation. What You'll Do Bring global flood models to the local scale Take state-of-the-art hydrological ML models (LSTMs, Transformers) trained on large-sample datase

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Global Direct Procurement (all genders)
jobs.description:
The role

HelloFresh manages approximately €1.7B in annual direct procurement spend across ingredients and packaging, covering markets in the EU, US, Canada, ANZ, and the UK. This role builds the cost intelligence capability for Global Procurement. You will create the analytical models and frameworks that give the business clear visibility into what ingredients really cost: where those costs come from, how they move, and where the opportunities lie. Your work will give regional teams the insight they need to make well-grounded decisions and to track progress against the group's cost reduction ambitions. This is a role for a senior procurement professional who is comfortable with detailed analysis and who can explain complex numbers simply to senior leaders and to colleagues in markets. You will be recognized as the go-to expert on cost across the team.

What you’ll do

  • Develop a harmonized cost measurement methodology with Finance and regional procurement teams, so that ingredient savings are defined, measured, and reported consistently across all markets.
  • Build should-cost models and total cost of ownership frameworks for priority categories, breaking unit price into its drivers (origin, processing method, logistics, certification, and shelf life), and use them to identify savings and inform sourcing decisions.
  • Track ingredient price drivers across markets, including contract prices,

About Davis Davis is an AI-native real estate company accelerating early-stage development and architectural design. Today developers coordinate 4-5 fragmented stakeholders over weeks or months. Soon they'll need only one: Davis.
